about.founder_narrative: Mr. Muhammad Hussain Muhammad Baroom didn't start with an office. He started on-site â€” reading soil reports, walking foundations, learning construction from the ground up in Jeddah during the Kingdom's formative infrastructure decade. By the time he established Nazrah Al Alam General Contracting, he had already spent years proving that a contractor's reputation is built on two things: what he delivers, and what he doesn't promise when he can't. Twenty-five years later, the company he founded operates one of Jeddah's most diversified contractor fleets â€” Komatsu bulldozers, CAT excavators, JCB backhoe loaders, CAT and Perkins generators from 25 to 600 kilowatts â€” and has delivered projects ranging from 20-villa residential developments in Al Johara Al Mohammadiah to commercial centers on Tahliyah Street. The philosophy hasn't changed: take fewer projects than the market offers, execute each one better than the client expects. No corners. No delays that aren't disclosed. No surprises on delivery day. Nazrah Al Alam is now a field-tested contracting firm with institutional discipline, a proven workforce, and a track record spanning residential, commercial, mosque, petrol station, and GRC decorative faÃ§ade work across Jeddah's most demanding neighborhoods.

vision_mission_values.vision: To be the contractor that Jeddah's developers call first â€” not because we are the largest, but because we are the most dependable.
vision_mission_values.mission: To execute every project with the precision our clients paid for, the safety our workers deserve, and the timeline we committed to â€” every single time, without exception.

values.title: Exactness
values.description: In measurement, in execution, in billing. No rounding errors on-site or off.

values.title: Accountability
values.description: Every site manager answers for every pour, every weld, every inspection â€” documented and traceable.

values.title: Safety
values.description: Zero-incident sites are non-negotiable. We stop work before we cut corners.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: Clients receive weekly progress reports, honest cost updates, and realistic timelines â€” not the ones they want to hear.

values.title: Continuity
values.description: We build long-term â€” relationships that extend past handover, and structures that outlast their first owners.

services.title: Civil & Structural Works
services.description: Reinforced concrete frames, load-bearing walls, raft foundations, retaining structures â€” we execute the skeleton that every other trade depends on. Our structural teams work from stamped engineering drawings and do not proceed without approved inspection. From ground-breaking to topping-out, the structural phase defines schedule, and we protect it.

services.title: Mechanical Engineering
services.description: Plumbing, firefighting networks, HVAC systems, and mechanical utility installations â€” engineered for Saudi code compliance and long-service reliability. Our mechanical teams coordinate with structural and electrical simultaneously, preventing the expensive rework that kills timelines on multi-trade projects. We test, commission, and hand over with full as-built documentation.

services.title: Electrical Systems
services.description: From low-voltage distribution boards to medium-voltage switchgear, lighting design, and BMS wiring â€” our licensed electrical teams carry the work from conduit to commissioning. We do not subcontract the critical path. Solar-ready designs available on request for Vision 2030-aligned projects across Jeddah and the wider Kingdom.

services.title: Infrastructure Development
services.description: Road sub-base and surfacing, storm drainage, sewerage networks, underground utility corridors, and site leveling at scale â€” executed with our owned fleet of bulldozers, loaders, and excavators. We mobilize fast, manage earthworks precisely, and close sites clean. Infrastructure is not glamorous work. We do it right anyway.

services.title: Building Maintenance
services.description: Preventive maintenance contracts, corrective repairs, and emergency response for commercial and residential buildings across Jeddah. Structural crack surveys, waterproofing remediation, MEP system overhauls â€” scheduled and reactive. Our maintenance crews are on standby. Response within four hours, guaranteed in every contract we sign.

services.title: Interior Fit-Out & Renovation
services.description: Commercial office fit-out, retail interior, high-end residential finishing, GRC decorative faÃ§ade elements, porcelain and marble installation, suspended ceilings, and joinery â€” coordinated under one contract. We have completed GRC decorative work on commercial areas in Al Amir Fawaz district. Samples and workshop visits available before contract signature.

services.title: Equipment Rental & Fleet
services.description: Hire by the day, week, or month â€” with operator, without operator, or on a full-service wet-lease basis. Four bulldozer models, six wheel loader variants, CAT 320 excavator, JCB 3CX backhoe, telehandler boom truck, 10-meter mobile light towers, and CAT/Perkins generators from 25 to 600 kilowatts. No brokerage. You deal directly with the owner.

equipment_categories.description: Four models â€” Komatsu D475, CAT D9N, CAT D8K, Komatsu D155 â€” covering mass earthmoving, land clearance, and compaction from 37 to 108 metric tons of operating weight. Available with ROPS-certified operators experienced in Jeddah's mixed soil and coastal substrate conditions.

Six models from CAT and XCMG â€” from the compact CAT 910 to the high-capacity CAT 966E and XCMG 958 â€” covering bucket capacities from 1.2 to 3.1 cubic meters. For aggregate handling, site clean-up, and bulk material loading across residential and commercial projects.

The CAT 320 hydraulic excavator at 20 metric tons â€” the most-deployed mid-range excavator in Jeddah â€” handles foundation trenching, utility installation, and debris removal on tight urban sites. Bucket, ripper, and hydraulic hammer attachments available on request.

The JCB 3CX â€” 74 kW, 8.46 metric tons, nearly six meters of dig depth â€” is the utility knife of construction sites. Trenching, backfilling, loading, and tight-space grading in a single machine. Widely used on our residential and infrastructure projects across Jeddah's established neighborhoods.

Our telehandler boom truck reaches 14 meters with a 3.5-metric-ton rated capacity â€” purpose-built for material placement on upper floors without mobile crane costs. Standard on commercial fit-out and faÃ§ade work projects where access is restricted and schedule is tight.

Ten-meter mobile lighting towers with four 1,000-watt metal halide lamps each â€” covering up to 5,000 square meters per tower. For night-shift concrete pours, security lighting during mobilization, and continuous MEP work after daylight hours on multi-phase projects.

CAT and Perkins diesel generators from 25 to 600 kilowatts â€” soundproofed and open configurations. For temporary site power, planned outage backup for commercial operations, and continuous-duty power on projects outside the grid. Load banks available for commissioning tests before client handover.

why_choose_us.title: We Own Our Fleet
why_choose_us.description: No subcontracted equipment surprises. Every bulldozer, loader, excavator, generator, and light tower is owned and maintained by Nazrah Al Alam. You know what is coming to site before it arrives.

why_choose_us.title: 25 Years in Jeddah's Market
why_choose_us.description: We have seen the soil conditions, the municipal permit cycles, the supplier chains, and the inspection regimes. That institutional memory cuts weeks off project timelines.

why_choose_us.title: Simultaneous Multi-Trade Execution
why_choose_us.description: Civil, mechanical, and electrical teams coordinate under one project manager â€” not three separate subcontractors negotiating schedule priority among themselves.

why_choose_us.title: Documented Site Management
why_choose_us.description: Daily site reports. Weekly photographic progress records. Milestone-tied invoicing. Nothing about your project stays opaque.

why_choose_us.title: No Ghost Supervision
why_choose_us.description: The engineer who signs your contract reviews your site personally. Not a junior site runner with a phone and authority he has not been given.

why_choose_us.title: Post-Handover Accountability
